minimum_dataset_fields.reason: Distinguishes SET50 from SET100 and other indices.
Preserves the symbol published at the historical date.
Resolves identity across ticker changes and prevents ticker-only joins.
Separates active, removed, replacement and boundary records.
Links mergers, amalgamations, listings and delistings.
Constrains price eligibility and listing boundaries.
Makes the delivered extract auditable and reproducible.
Independent identity key when tickers change.
Needed only if supplied as part of a separately defined price policy.

request_checklist.request: Provide all 22 canonical half-year SET50 snapshots from 2016 H1 through 2026 H2, with index name and effective start/end dates.
Identify all between-period revisions, replacement events, corrections and superseded files.
Provide historical security identifiers, exchange codes, issuer/security names and ticker history.
Document ticker changes, mergers/amalgamations, successors, delistings, relistings and listing dates.
State whether each row is a member, replacement, removal or boundary record and provide the effective date.
Provide source URL/product name, extraction date, file version, revision number and correction history.
Confirm that internal quantitative research, audit retention and derived research reports are permitted.
Specify format, schema, encoding, date/time convention, missing-value convention and checksum/versioning.

acceptance_criteria: Effective dates and index name are explicit.
Security identity is explicit or resolvable with official identifiers.
Between-period revisions and corrections are documented.
Source provenance, version and licensing are preserved.
TRUE/TRUEE/DTAC, GULF/INTUCH/GULFI, TIDLOR, BANPU/BANPUU, SCB/SCBB, TMB/TTB and MRDIYT reconcile without synthetic continuity.
rejection_criteria: Missing canonical periods or implicit effective dates.
Ticker-only identity with no authoritative security mapping.
Unexplained revisions, between-period changes or corporate-action boundaries.
Unknown provenance, unverifiable corrections, or unsuitable licensing.
Requirement to infer membership from current constituents or to fabricate continuity.
membership_only_consequence: Membership lists alone are insufficient for price acquisition; obtain a separate official security master covering identifiers, names, ticker history, listing/delisting and corporate actions before mapping prices.
recommended_route: SET Historical Data Request, with an explicit request for the membership plus security-reference bundle; use SETSMART/SMART Marketplace as alternatives or cross-checks if their product scope is confirmed.
